title: RCA: Phishing SMS Campaign Impersonating NovaTel (INC-2026-0197)
content:
RCA: Phishing SMS Campaign Impersonating NovaTel (INC-2026-0197)

Document ID: RCA_INC_2026_0197

Category: C18 — Security & Fraud

Department: Security

Customer Scope: all

Version: 1.0    Last Updated: 2026-08-08    Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base

Incident Reference

INC-2026-0197

Problem Statement

A third-party phishing campaign impersonated NovaTel billing alerts via SMS, directing customers to a malicious link.

Root Cause

External bad actors spoofed NovaTel's SMS sender ID format; this is an external attack rather than an internal system failure, but response coordination had gaps.

Contributing Factors

Delay of several hours between first customer reports and the broadcast anti-fraud alert.

No pre-existing rapid-takedown relationship with the specific hosting provider used for the phishing domain.

Corrective Actions

Reduce the customer-report-to-broadcast-alert threshold via an automated spike-detection rule on fraud-report volume (target: 30 days).

Establish standing takedown-request relationships with major hosting providers via the industry CERT-In liaison channel.

Status

Action 1 completed; Action 2 in progress; owner: Security team.
